candidates.change_summary: Replace the constant return value `true` with `false`.
Replace the for-loop body’s external `call` target from `caddress` to `address(this)`.
Replace the function selector to `transfer(address,uint256)`.
Delete the `require(_s)` call so a failing external call does not revert the whole transaction.
Change the require precondition from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length >= 0 so zero-length arrays are accepted.
Change the base-case transfer return value from true to false while keeping the same successful call path.
Change the require check from requiring at least one recipient to requiring an empty recipient array, changing when the function completes.
Change the call selector to the ERC20 transfer selector instead of transferFrom, changing the callee behavior.
Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert for nonempty arrays.
Change the loop increment from i++ to i+=2, skipping every other recipient.
Swap the arguments passed to the external call so v is passed as the recipient and _tos[i] as the amount.
Remove the require on the boolean success flag, ignoring failed external calls.
Return false instead of true after successful completion.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so empty _tos no longer reverts.
Replace the selector hash string so the external call encodes a different function selector.
Delete the require(_s) so a failing external call no longer reverts.
Change the loop condition to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert.
Change the loop increment to i += 2, skipping every other recipient.
Replace the arguments of the external call so from and _tos[i] are swapped.
Replace the return value to false.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so empty _tos arrays no longer revert.
Replace the transferFrom selector hash string with a different method name, causing calls to target a different selector and likely revert on failure.
Change loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length so the loop indexes out of bounds and reverts.
Replace require(_s) with require(!_s) so successful external calls revert and failed calls do not.
Replace return true with return false so the function completes but with a different returned boolean.
